result.description: Shared-inbox customer support platform (email, chat, knowledge base) with conversations, customers, and reporting.
result.auth_detail: Inbox/Mailbox API 2.0: OAuth2 (auth-code for multi-account apps, client-credentials for single account) with app created under Profile > My apps. Separate Docs API: per-user API key sent as HTTP Basic username with dummy password.
result.access_detail: Developers create OAuth apps self-serve in their own Help Scout account; no app review found for creating apps. Help Scout is a paid product (Standard/Plus/Pro, trial-based, no free tier), so working credentials need a trial or paid account. Reports endpoints are Plus/Pro only. Not verified: whether the API is plan-gated on Standard.
result.api_notes: Inbox API 2.0 (https://api.helpscout.net/v2, HAL+JSON): conversations and threads, customers, mailboxes/folders/fields/saved replies, tags, users, teams, workflows, reports (Plus/Pro), webhooks. Rate limit 200 req/min. Separate Docs API (KB) with API-key Basic auth.
result.blocker: No free tier; credentials need a trial or paid account. Reports need Plus/Pro. Docs API uses a separate API-key auth from the OAuth2 Inbox API.

evidence.quote: The primary REST API for managing Help Scout conversations, customers, and support operations.
With Help Scout's MCP server, AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor can securely retrieve the customer knowledge already stored in your Help Scout account.
